- **Ear_rots_Diplodia**: White mold from base, bleached husks are characteristic; grayish-brown discoloration; reference also shows similar field appearance
- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight**: Leaf disease — does not match

The test image shows brownish-reddish kernel discoloration (consistent with Gibberella's pink-red coloration that has faded/aged) and the overall field presentation matches the Gibberella reference top-left image very closely. The husks are bleached and the overall ear color is gray-brown. The Diplodia reference shows more uniform whitish mold covering kernels, while the test image shows more of the reddish-brownish kernel discoloration typical of Gibberella.
